desc:
Hmm... with the way it's worded in *SCoOW,* it seems Chen is Ran's one and only shikigami. She doesn't have tens or hundreds under her disposal, despite what her stated signature ability seems to suggest. 🤔 Maybe she's still starting out? That's why she only has Chen, who you can actually dispel out of the bakeneko body by just splashing water on her.

On the other hand, it is stated there that Yukari does have **multiple** shikigami – with Ran being the one she uses the most.
